{{Quote|The Republic fleet obliterated the Imperial squadron, and the Battle of Bothawui became the Republic's first major victory in the war.|[[Jedi Master/Legends|Jedi Master]] [[Gnost-Dural]]|audio=BattleOfBothawui-Timeline5.flac|<ref name="Timeline 5" />}}
The '''First Battle of Bothawui''', also known simply as the '''Battle of Bothawui''', was a [[Navy/Legends|naval]] conflict between the [[Sith Empire (Post–Great Hyperspace War)|Sith Empire]] and the [[Galactic Republic/Legends|Galactic Republic]] during the [[Great Galactic War]]. Following the return of the Empire and its initial victories in the [[Outer Rim Territories/Legends|Outer Rim Territories]] in the early stages of the war, the [[Tenebrae|Sith Emperor]] turned his sights toward the [[Mid Rim/Legends|Mid Rim]] in [[3671 BBY]], with [[Bothawui/Legends|Bothawui]] as his first target. [[Admiral/Legends|Admiral]] [[Greik]] of the [[Republic Navy/Legends|Republic Navy]] predicted the attack, and so took approved the daring tactics of the [[combat analysis droid]] [[B-3G9]] and assembled the entirety of his [[Fleet/Legends|fleet]] of [[Warship/Legends|warships]] over the [[Planet/Legends|world]]. The incursion was a disaster for the Empire, as the Republic force was ready for the attack. The entire [[Imperial Navy (Sith Empire)|Imperial Armada]] strike fleet was wiped out, but the Empire's defeat during its first attempt at taking Bothawui only served to provoke their [[Battle of Bothawui (Second; Great Galactic War)|second]], more aggressive attack.

==Prelude==
{{Quote|After the Sith offensive seized the Seswenna sector of the Outer Rim, the Imperial Armada tuned its sights closer to the Core. The Mid Rim.|[[Jedi Master/Legends|Jedi Master]] [[Gnost-Dural]]|audio=TheMidRim-Timeline5.flac|<ref name="Timeline 5" />}}
Since the start of the [[Great Galactic War]] in [[3681 BBY]], the [[Sith Empire (Post–Great Hyperspace War)|Sith Empire]] was widely successful in its campaigns in the [[Outer Rim Territories/Legends|Outer Rim Territories]],<ref name="Encyclopedia">''[[Star Wars: The Old Republic Encyclopedia]]''.</ref> but only made minor incursions into the [[Mid Rim/Legends|Mid Rim]]. Even these negligible attempts at expanding the war were often met with failure,<ref name="Mid Rim">While some sources, such as ''[[Star Wars: The Old Republic]]'', ''[[The Old Republic, Blood of the Empire Act 1: Shades of the Sith]]'', and ''[[Star Wars: The Old Republic Encyclopedia]]'' make mention of Imperial actions in the Mid Rim prior to the First Battle of Bothawui&mdash;such as the [[Battle of Talay]], the [[engagement in the Mid Rim]], and the [[Battle of Bomodon]]&mdash;most sources, including ''The Old Republic Encyclopedia'' and ''The Old Republic'', clarify that the First Battle of Bothawui was the Empire's first significant attempt at penetrating the Mid Rim.</ref> but after the Imperial [[Third battle of the Seswenna sector|seizure]] of the [[Seswenna sector/Legends|Seswenna sector]] in the Outer Rim in [[3671 BBY]],<ref name="Date" /> the [[Tenebrae|Sith Emperor]] began planning his [[Imperial Military (Sith Empire)|military's]] full forward progression toward the [[Core Worlds/Legends|Core Worlds]]. The first step in this plan was to finally conquer the Mid Rim&mdash;more specifically, the [[Bothan Space/Legends|Bothan sector]].<ref name="Timeline 5" /> Anticipating this development, [[Admiral/Legends|Admiral]] [[Greik]] of the [[Republic Navy/Legends|Republic Navy]] began planning a counterattack;<ref name="JoMGD" /> in a strategy devised by the expert [[combat analysis droid]], [[B-3G9]],<ref name="GS B-3G9" /> Greik amassed the entirety of the Republic fleet in the [[Both system]] to defend against an Imperial invasion of the [[Planet/Legends|planet]] [[Bothawui/Legends|Bothawui]].<ref name="JoMGD" />

==The battle==
{{Quote|Believing the Republic was still recovering from its heavy losses, Imperial forces charged into Bothan Space where they were caught off guard by the full force of the Republic fleet.|Jedi Master Gnost-Dural|audio=CaughOffGuard-Timeline5.flac|<ref name="Timeline 5" />}}
[[File:FirstBattleofBothawui-GGW.jpg|thumb|left|250px|The Sith fleet is annihilated over Bothawui.]]
Believing that the forces of the Republic [[Navy/Legends|Navy]] were still recovering from the Outer Rim campaign, the Imperial armada hastily rushed into [[Bothan/Legends|Bothan]] [[Realspace/Legends|Space]],<ref name="Timeline 5" /> and a fleet of [[Harrower-class dreadnought|''Harrower''-class dreadnoughts]] found themselves in a severely mismatched battle against the entire Republic [[Fleet/Legends|fleet]] in [[Orbit/Legends|orbit]] above Bothawui itself. The Republic force, consisting of numerous [[Thranta-class corvette|''Thranta''-class corvettes]]<ref name="Timeline 5" /> and at least one [[Valor-class cruiser|''Valor''-class cruiser]], the ''[[Intercessor]]'',<ref name="Clouds of Vondoru" /> battered the Sith forces into submission. The Imperial fleet was caught completely off-guard and was quickly overwhelmed by the Republic [[Starship/Legends|vessels]], which obliterated all of the invading forces,<ref name="Timeline 5" /> including the [[Sith Lord/Legends|Sith Lord]] [[Darth Immern]].<ref name="GS MZ-12" /> The [[Kel Dor/Legends|Kel Dor]] [[Jedi Knight/Legends|Jedi Knight]] [[Gnost-Dural]], who had recently been transferred to the Republic Navy after serving for many [[Standard year/Legends|years]] in the [[Minos Cluster Campaign|embattled]] of the [[Minos Cluster/Legends|Minos Cluster]], served with the fleet during the battle,<ref name="JoMGD" /> as did the Bothan Jedi [[Kutri O'a]].<ref name="Kutri">{{TORcite|exp=shadow|type=codex|Master Kutri O'a}}</ref>

==Aftermath==
{{Quote|The news spread across the galaxy, rekindling lost hopes and re-energizing exhausted defenders. The Republic fleet moved on, but a courageous force of Jedi and Republic soldiers remained on Bothawui to await the Empire's return.|Jedi Master Gnost-Dural|audio=AwaitEmpiresReturn-Timeline5.flac|<ref name="Timeline 5" />}}
[[File:Bothawui_news.jpg|thumb|right|250px|News of the Republic's victory at Bothawui spreads across the galaxy.]]
The conflict at Bothawui was the Republic's first major victory against the Empire since the war had begun. News of the battle spread across the [[HoloNet/Legends|HoloNet]], restoring the morale of the people of the Republic and reinvigorating its jaded [[Republic Military/Legends|military]]. The bulk of Bothawui's defense forces soon moved on, once again scattering throughout [[The galaxy/Legends|the galaxy]] to combat the Empire.<ref name="Timeline 5" /> To protect from retribution, the Republic commissioned [[Engineer/Legends|engineers]] to construct a new, high-powered [[Bothawui planetary shield|planetary shield]] on Bothawui's surface. To protect the shield itself, a dedicated contingent of [[Jedi/Legends|Jedi]] and Republic [[Soldier/Legends|soldiers]] remained on the planet in anticipation of the Empire's retribution.<ref name="JoMGD" />

The Empire indeed returned, this time with a massive invasion army intended to overwhelm Bothawui. The remaining Republic forces under the command of [[Jedi Master/Legends|Jedi Master]] [[Belth Allusis]] were wiped out during their [[Battle of Bothawui (Second; Great Galactic War)|fight]] to protect the planet, but were ultimately able to repel the [[Sith/Legends|Sith]] from Bothawui. The battles at Bothawui restored hope to a discouraged Republic and empowered its defenders to continue fighting the war for several decades.<ref name="Timeline 5" /> B-3G9, the droid hero of the First Battle of Bothawui, was rewarded for the victory with an order for it to be upgraded and undergo maintenance at its [[Czerka Arms/Legends|Czerka Corporation]] factory of origin. However, due to an administrative error, the droid underwent a partial circuit remapping to remake it as a standard [[Protocol droid/Legends|protocol droid]]. The mix-up diminished B-3G9's tactical analysis programming, removing it from command status but allowing it to continue serving the Republic as a manager of individual starship defense systems.<ref name="GS B-3G9" />

Following the conclusion of the war with the signing of the [[Treaty of Coruscant]], the then-Jedi Master Gnost-Dural made a [[Holodocumentary|holorecord]] that detailed the Empire's attempts at taking Bothawui.<ref name="Timeline 5" /> Additionally, his [[The Journal of Master Gnost-Dural|journal]] of war stories, which included an account of the battle over Bothawui, was added to the [[Jedi Archives (Tython)|Jedi Archives]] on [[Tython/Legends|Tython]] by [[Grand Master/Legends|Grand Master]] [[Satele Shan]], who also included an anecdote regarding the Bothawui victory.<ref name="JoMGD" />

==Behind the scenes==
The First Battle of Bothawui was introduced in the [[Timeline 5: The Battle of Bothawui|fifth installment]] of the ''[[Galactic Timeline]]'',<ref name="Timeline 5" /> released in [[2009]],<ref name="Release">{{TORweb|url=news/news-article/20091023_001|text=The Battle of Bothawui|nolive=1}}</ref> an [[in-universe]] account of the events leading up to the massively multiplayer online [[Star Wars video games|video game]] from [[LucasArts]] and [[BioWare]] titled ''[[Star Wars: The Old Republic]]'', released in [[2011]]. The timeline is narrated by Kel-Dor Jedi Master Gnost-Dural, whose voice is provided by actor [[Lance Henriksen]].<ref name="Timeline 5" /> While this battle is referred to as simply the "Battle of Bothawui" by most sources, the following, more prominent battle is also referred to as the "Battle of Bothawui." The [[2013]] Digital Expansion for ''The Old Republic'', titled ''[[Star Wars: The Old Republic: Galactic Starfighter]]'' was the first to identify the battle as the First Battle of Bothawui.<ref name="GS MZ-12" />
